classification: post-hoc low-turnover B-leg experiment after 5x cost fragility; no holding-period grid
discipline: No holding-period grid: only 40 days is tested.
No scoring, stop-loss, TopN, cap, asset or overlay-parameter changes.
No paper target or order file.
disclosure: R334/R335 kept the portfolio positive at 5x but stock net contribution became too concentrated. Existing h20 B-leg turnover is a major cost source. R337 changes only the B leg maximum holding period from 20 to 40 trading days, aligning it with the A leg, and keeps every other rule fixed.

fixed_strategy.center: 60-day overlay lookback, 15% target vol, gross [0.2,1.0], no leverage

gates.5x_concentration: C1-C12 under 5x costs; top1/top3/top5 net contribution <=25%/55%/75%
gates.asset_substitution: all three R331 asset substitutions pass
gates.cost: 3x conservative, 4x and 5x total return >0; 5x Sharpe >=0.5 and MDD >= -25%
gates.fresh_starts: at least 4/5 positive and every MDD >= -18%
gates.full_2x: all R334/R332 performance and concentration gates with 2022/2023 >=0
gates.plateau: at least 7/9 overlay and 2/3 joint target variants pass all core gates

known_limitations: In-sample candidate; not independent out-of-sample proof.
ETF qfq and current industry snapshot limitations remain.
Longer holding may improve cost but worsen responsiveness.
selection_rule: All gates must pass; otherwise record low-turnover B as a negative result and do not promote.
